Arts Commission

  Inglewood, California
  June 21, 2023

A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission was convened on June 21, 2023.
Commissioner Lesure called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m. followed by the flag salute.

Stephanie Maldonado announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Commissioner Olivia Alvitre ‐ District 2, Commissioner at Large
  Jacques Lesure ‐ District 3, Commissioner Vicki Perryman-Banks -
  District 4

  Absent:  Commissioner Aletha Metcalf, Commissioner Phyllis Battle

City Personnel present were as follows:

  Sabrina Barnes  Parks, Recreation, and Community Services Director
  Helen Lessick  Public Art Consultant
  Stephanie Maldonado  Senior Management Assistant

PUBLIC COMMENTS. None

MINUTES. It was moved by Commissioner Banks and seconded by Commissioner Alvitre
that the minutes for the Arts Commission Meeting held on February 15, 2023, and March
15, 2023, be approved. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Alvitre, Lesure, and Banks
Noes: None

STAFF REPORT. Utility Box Art Program Contract for Creative Services. Staff report
recommending the Arts Commission recommend the Mayor and Council Members
approve an agreement with The Creative House in the amount of $29,564.64, to realize a
pilot Utility Box Public Art Program. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Alvitre, Lesure, and Banks
Noes: None

  1
   Arts Commission

VERBAL REPORTS. Public Art‐Related Projects.
  1. IGAP 2022 Project Update: Work in progress at 1019 W. Manchester studio; to be
  installed at Senior Center lobby, June 30, 2023.
  2. Public Art Conservation Update: Conservation of Tom Van Sant’s The Written
  Word column; at Main Library Manchester façade on June 15–30; cleaning ground
  level and application of anti-graffiti coating by Rosa Lowinger and Associates.

PUBLIC REMARKS. Kip Hannan, a former 20-year employee of Hollywood Park who
worked in the television department stopped by the meeting to hear the Arts Commission
discussions about where SoFi has placed any of the Hollywood Park memorabilia.

COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR.
  1. Inglewood Music Festival, Saturday, June 24, 2023 – Free at Darby Park 3400 W.
  Arbor Vitae St. (10 a.m. to 9 p.m.)
  2. Movies in the Park – Free Outdoor filming screenings, and events start at dusk:
  Saturday, June 24 at Edward Vincent Park; Saturday, July 15 at Inglewood City Hall;
  Saturday, August 12 at North Park.
  3. Center for Cultural Innovation – Cali Catalyst - $7,500 unrestricted grants for CA-
  based artists.

There being no further business to be presented, Helen Lessick declared the meeting
adjourned, at 7:00 p.m.
